dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2008-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
